places.quote: that staid old house near the Green at Richmond
places.note: Green is the locating landmark for the house; outside London.

places.quote: we sat apart at a darkening window of the house in Richmond
places.note: Then a separate town in Surrey, outside London.

places.quote: The time has come round when Miss Havisham wishes to have me for a day at Satis.
places.note: Fictional house; the novel locates it in Kent, not London.

places.quote: I heard of her often in town
places.note: Implicit reference to London via the idiom 'in town'.
